I have 0.21 hectares of sorghum here, and the rains in Tigray have not been kind these past seasons. I went to school a little, so I know about DAP and urea from the cooperative, but for such a small plot I cannot afford a full bag — last year I bought half a bag of DAP with a neighbor and we split it. My oxen manure I save for this plot since I own it, and I plant the local sorghum seed my father grew because it stands the dry spells better than what the agro-dealer brings. I do all the weeding myself with my wife and two older children — no money for hired hands on sorghum.
